metadata.label: Reachy primitive scheduler + documented adaptation
metadata.seed_note: Reachy is deterministic; repetitions differ by start beat 16/64/112
metadata.correction_description: Misty pose-to-pose retargeting controller (user request 2026-11-21). The Misty head moves rest-to-rest between commanded poses and cannot follow poses closer than ~0.35 s. (1) clip the Reachy-adapted q to the profile limits with a 2% margin; (2) choose keyposes on the quarter-beat grid by greedy max-deviation simplification of the Reachy curve (extremes and primitive switches first), at least MIN_LEG s apart, until the remaining deviation is below KEY_TOL rad; (3) join keyposes with rest-to-rest minimum-jerk quintics (Misty's own pose-to-pose behaviour); (4) if a leg exceeds vmax/amax, shorten THAT leg's displacement only (direction kept). Chunk end is rest + terminal hold. Timing on the beat grid is unchanged; amplitude is reduced only where the hardware limits demand it. Per-chunk log: keyposes, limited legs, scales, clip.
metadata.execution_chunking: 4-beat rest-to-rest chunks + 0.20 s terminal hold (no-queue controller)
metadata.spline: see correction_description; per-chunk log in summary planner stats
